title: eBay Classifieds Group: Shared Platforms, Local Brands and a Sale
basis: Reconstructed on 2026-11-12 from the published index.md (paragraph for paragraph, in its own order) and spec.md (accepted 2026-10-21), which it replaces. Intent outcome, the four acceptance criteria, the thesis and the role are copied unchanged from the case-ebay-classifieds entry in journal-spec.json. Added: one opening clause carrying over from case-olx (p01), a roadmap paragraph (p04) and a conclusion under its own heading (p62 new; p63 is the published closing paragraph moved there).

know: eCG's portfolio built two ways from 2004 (bought national leaders such as Marktplaats, mobile.de, Gumtree, dba.dk and 2dehands, and greenfield launches, several later closed or sold) and sold to Adevinta for about US$9.2 billion (agreed July 2020, completed June 2021).

The shared layers by interface type: a search-engine choice made together and migrated brand by brand after eBay's Voyager was abandoned, a group PaaS, the MoVe motors supply platform with a published Listing API, sandbox and typed webhooks, one external payment institution, and a regional Benelux platform; and inside one brand, Kleinanzeigen's event backbone and per-user migration out of its monolith.

What the sale exposed: transitional services for Gumtree UK written into the UK regulator's 2021 remedy, support for the Australian businesses 'during the transition', and years of domain, design-system and platform work to remove the eBay name.
believe: The type of interface behind a shared capability predicts what it costs to separate.
A group should share the professional supply side of verticals before consumer products.
can_do: Keep a dependency register per brand listing everything it uses but does not own, with an owner and a replacement path.
Classify a group's shared capabilities by interface type and say which would need transitional services in a sale.

audience.who: Chief and enterprise architects of marketplace groups, platform and search leads, and engineering directors who integrate acquired marketplaces or prepare one for sale.
already_knows: What an API, a database, an event stream, a search engine and Kubernetes are.
How to make and defend an architecture decision.
Part IX's evidence rules, from part-9, and Adevinta's record, from case-adevinta.
Global components, tenancy and consolidation sequencing, from multi-country-platforms and platform-consolidation; Veldmark and its Common Ground program, from meet-veldmark.
does_not_know: eCG-specific names: Voyager, PanteraS, MoVe, Online Payment Platform, Gelijk Oversteken.
Transitional services agreements (TSAs) and undertakings in lieu.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Given a list of a brand's shared dependencies, the reader uses eCG's record to say which would separate cleanly in a sale, which would need transitional services, and what to keep before any sale is in sight.
acceptance_criteria.probe: A group may sell one country's marketplace in two years. That marketplace uses a search engine chosen jointly with its sister brands, a payment provider contracted by the group, a dealer-listing API the group publishes, and an internal fraud service owned by the parent with no written interface. Using only this chapter: which of these does eCG's record suggest would separate cleanly, which would not, and what should the group keep now?
acceptance_criteria.expected: The jointly chosen engine (an agreement), the external payment provider and the published dealer API (a published contract, like MoVe's Listing API and webhooks) are the interface types that left the cleanest record; the parent-owned fraud service with no written interface is the undocumented parent dependency that needed a regulator's transitional-services remedy for Gumtree UK. Keep a dependency register per brand with an owner and replacement path, and give every shared capability a written interface a third party could operate.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A reader of the opening alone (the callouts and the paragraphs before the first heading) can predict the chapter's questions, its evidence and where it ends.
acceptance_criteria.probe: After reading only the callouts and the paragraphs before the first heading: what questions will this chapter ask, what kind of evidence will it use, and how will it end?
acceptance_criteria.expected: Questions of what eCG shared, at which layer and through what kind of interface, what stayed local, and what the sale revealed about the coupling; evidence scattered across brand blogs in Amsterdam and Berlin, a GitHub organization, conference talks, archived job postings and a regulator's decision, with the group's own silence treated as evidence; the case as the mirror image of Adevinta, linking to it for everything after 2021; a closing test of Veldmark's Common Ground program.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A reverse outline of the chapter, written without the spec, lists the same controlling ideas in the same order as the post spec's sections and paragraphs.

Every statement about eBay Classifieds Group's internal systems that no cited source documents sits in a callout or figure caption labeled as inference, and every company fact outside those labels carries its source and publication year.
acceptance_criteria.probe: Is there any sentence outside an `INFERENCE, NOT DOCUMENTED` callout or a labeled figure caption that describes how eBay Classifieds Group builds or runs a system without a dated source, or a company fact with no source and year?
acceptance_criteria.expected: None. Undocumented internals appear only in labeled inference callouts or captions; each company fact names its source and year in the sentence or the timeline; the author's interpretation is marked 'my reading' or sits in the Chief Architect's view.

thesis.question: How thin a shared layer did eBay Classifieds Group run beneath its national brands, through which kinds of interface, and what did the 2020–2021 sale expose about that coupling?
thesis.claim: eCG left each national leader owning its own platform and product and coordinated them through a thin, selective shared layer (a search-engine choice made together but migrated brand by brand, a group PaaS, a motors supply platform with published partner contracts, one external payment institution), and its sale showed that the type of interface predicted the cost of separation: no remedy in the public record touches the agreements, the external provider or the published contracts, while dependence on the parent had to be written into a competition remedy as transitional services for Gumtree UK, and removing the eBay name from the brands Adevinta kept took years of domain, design-system and platform work.
thesis.disputed_by: The view that what a divestment costs is set by the deal structure and the regulators, not by the kind of interface between a parent and its brands; and with it, the view that a federation which never consolidated its consumer products wasted its scale and should have integrated its brands onto one product platform.
thesis.so_what: A Chief Architect requires a written interface for every shared capability even when no third party is in sight; keeps a dependency register per brand with an owner and a replacement path for every system, data flow and contract it uses but does not own; shares the professional supply side of verticals, such as dealer stock entered once and shown in several marketplaces, before consumer products; makes group decisions on shared choices and funds local teams to migrate; and treats a parent's technology as a supplier with an end date.
thesis.how_why: eBay entered classifieds in 2004 by buying national leaders and agreed in July 2020 to sell the whole group to Adevinta for about US$9.2 billion; the sale completed in June 2021. When eBay stopped investing in Voyager, the search engine it had given its subsidiaries, eCG companies chose a replacement together and each migrated alone (Marktplaats in three months with two or three developers). MoVe dispatched dealer listings to Kijiji.ca and kijijiautos.ca through a published API and webhooks; Kleinanzeigen rebuilt 34 million documents from a compacted event topic in under 30 minutes in 2019 and in 2025 migrated users one at a time out of its monolith. The UK regulator's 2021 decision required eBay to offer transitional services to Gumtree UK's buyer, Adevinta promised to support the Australian businesses 'during the transition', and several brands were sold again within 18 months. The group published almost nothing about itself, and that silence is evidence of how federated it was.

supporting_claims.claim: eCG's durable value sat in national leaders that eBay bought and left running on their own platforms; most greenfield launches under group brands were closed, renamed or sold, so the group had little reason to replace the platforms that won their markets.

The shared layer was thin and selective, and each documented layer sat behind a different kind of interface: a search-engine choice made by agreement and migrated brand by brand, group-built PaaS tooling, the MoVe motors supply platform behind published contracts, the parent's inventory programs, one external payment institution and one regional Benelux platform.

The deepest engineering in the record happened inside brands on their own paths: Kleinanzeigen's event backbone made its search index rebuildable, its 2025 whole-platform migration moved users one at a time, and mobile.de put dealers' exposure guarantees into ranking.

The sale turned shared dependencies into contract terms, and the interface type predicted the cost: eBay offered transitional services for Gumtree UK in the UK regulator's remedy, Adevinta promised the Australian businesses support during the transition, and the brands Adevinta kept spent years removing the eBay name from domains, apps and platforms.

eCG published almost nothing as a group, so its architecture is assembled from dated brand blogs, repositories, talks, job postings and a regulator's decision; every fact is dated, every inference labeled and the questions the record cannot answer are listed, not filled.

The record yields decision rules a Chief Architect can apply before any sale: prefer interfaces that can be handed over, keep a dependency register per brand, share the professional supply side of verticals first, coordinate choices and fund local migrations, and treat a parent's technology as a supplier with an end date; tested against the book's patterns and Veldmark, they hold.

role.contribution: Tests how thin a shared layer can be and shows a sale converting shared dependencies into contract terms, with the interface type predicting the cost.

additional_patterns.applies_to: trade-offs to evidence-stops: cross-phase views (by option, by vertical, by failure, by gap)
chief-architect to questions: rules from the record, their test against the book and Veldmark, and questions for the reader's group

flow.rationale: Reading rules and the timeline come first because every later sentence is a dated fact, a reading or an inference. The phases run in time order, because the sale can only expose dependencies the reader has already seen being built: the portfolio (Phase 1), the shared layers by interface type with Kleinanzeigen's own 2009–2019 backbone beside them (Phase 2), the sale (Phase 3) and its aftermath. The Berlin brands' 2024–2025 work follows the aftermath as a separate, later section on what stayed local under the new owner (not as aftermath evidence), so time never runs backwards. The cross-phase views come next because each uses facts from every phase; inside that group they run from what the record shows to what it cannot: the options set side by side by interface type (the central finding), then the same options by vertical, then what went wrong, then the gaps, which close the group so the rules that follow do not outrun them. The author's rules, the comparison and the questions come last because they apply what the record has shown.

paragraphs.controlling_idea: eBay assembled the portfolio by two routes, and their outcomes differ sharply.

sections.heading: Phase 2: A Federation with Group Functions (2009–2020)

flow.rationale: First the organization as seen from outside (who decided), then the shared layers one by one from the most local interface (a choice made by agreement) to the most external (a payment provider), then the regional exception with the layer map that sums them up, and last the local side: what one brand, Kleinanzeigen, built on its own between 2009 and 2019. The map comes after every layer because it summarizes them; Kleinanzeigen's backbone follows the map because it is the local counterpart of the shared layers and belongs to the same years, so the chapter does not have to jump back to 2009 after the sale. sections.heading: Phase 3: The Sale (2020–2021)

flow.rationale: From the July 2020 terms and their silence on technology, to what the regulator wrote in 2021, to the divestments of 2021–2022, to the author's reading of which brands needed help. The reading needs the regulator's sentence and the divestments in view first.

evidence.shows: Gives the deal's scale and its synergy case.

conclusion.heading: From eBay Classifieds to AVIV
conclusion.synthesis: The three questions give one answer: what the group shared was thin and chosen layer by layer, what stayed local was the national platforms that kept their value and could move to a new owner, and what the sale revealed depended on the interface each layer used. Choosing interfaces a third party could operate is what keeps a group free to keep, merge or sell each brand.
conclusion.so_what: A Chief Architect does not need to know whether a sale is coming to act on this: a dependency register per brand and a written interface for every shared capability cost little now and set the price of separation later.

callback.to: The hook: eBay entered classifieds in 2004 by buying national leaders and sold the group whole in 2021; and the group's public silence.
callback.how: The reader can now see that the leaders eBay bought and left on their own platforms were the ones that moved cleanly to a new owner, and that the group's silence matched how little it held in common.

takeaway.content: Start a dependency register per brand and require a written interface for every shared capability; read case-aviv next for a group that took the opposite route in one vertical.

hand_off.carries_over: eBay Classifieds' closing: a federation whose value lay in strong national platforms and whose shared layer was tested by a sale.
hand_off.introduces: One vertical, real estate, and a group that took the opposite route: it assembled national portals by acquisition and set out to make them work as one, with almost no engineering evidence to read.
